title: The judge who fined the whole courtroom ⚖️
caption:
He fined everyone in the room. Then the old man walked out with $47.50 ⚖️❤️
Would you have paid? 👇
first_comment: Would you have paid your 50 cents? 👇
sources: A widely retold anecdote about Fiorello La Guardia (Mayor of New York 1934-45, who sometimes sat in magistrates' court); it has not been confirmed by historians, so the reel says 'the story goes'
